notes: OWASP review of commit 76237e0 (test-run + preview endpoints). A01/IDOR: both testRun() and previewStep() call requireFunnel() FIRST, which delegates to projectService.requireOwned(ownerId,...) before any funnel lookup or side effect; the funnel is additionally filtered by projectId.equals(f.getProjectId()), and malformed ObjectId collapses to the same uniform 404 (MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND) — no existence oracle. In previewStep the requireFunnel-404 strictly precedes the findStep stepId-404, so a foreign funnel + bad stepId yields the requireFunnel 404, matching Decision 9. ownerId is derived exclusively from the authenticated session (controller currentUserId() reads AppUserDetails from SecurityContextHolder), never from the request body. test-run direct enroll is non-cross-tenant: projectId, funnel, owner subscriberId, and telegramBotId all derive from the owned funnel and the project's CONNECTED bot (resolveOwnerSubscriber + bot.getTelegramBotId()) — PreviewStepRequest/testRun bodies contribute no tenant-scoping value. A03/XSS: preview renders via VariableTemplateRenderer.render(), a pure StringBuilder that escapes ONLY substituted values per parse_mode (HTML escapes & < > and " for attribute-breakout; MarkdownV2 escapes the full special set + backslash; null/unknown mode = plain). The rendered string is returned as JSON data in PreviewStepResponse — no server-side HTML sink, no eval/deserialization of untrusted input. Stub subscriber uses static safe sample values and is never persisted. Sensitive data: PreviewStepResponse is exactly {rendered, sampleData, kind} (record) with no ownerChatId/token/telegram identity; getOwnerChatId() is used only internally for subscriber resolution. test-run returns bare 200 OK (ResponseEntity<Void>) leaking no internal ids. A05/A07/CSRF: both new @PostMapping endpoints live under /api/v1/projects/** which is covered by the appSecurityFilterChain — authenticated() plus CSRF enforced on mutating verbs via CsrfFilter.DEFAULT_CSRF_MATCHER (only /webhooks/telegram/{projectId} is path-negated; the api-key STATELESS chain is scoped to /api/integrations/**, not these endpoints). A04/insecure-design: the three not-linked branches collapse to a single 422 funnel_owner_not_linked (predictable business state, never 500); validateSteps reused for fail-fast pre-validation. validateSteps visibility raised from private to package-private only (same package com.botfunnel.funnel) with no logic/code change — no broadened exposure beyond same-package. PreviewStepRequest uses @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown=true) for mass-assignment defense. No hardcoded secrets, no SSRF (no user-controlled URL reaches an HTTP client), no sensitive logging added. Zero critical findings.
